payload.task_text:
I manage the purchasing department for our online store and I need to set up restock alerts for products that are running low on inventory. Please pull the complete product catalog from our e-commerce platform and identify every product that is currently out of stock, meaning the stock quantity is zero.

For each out-of-stock product, I need you to create a calendar reminder so we do not forget to reorder. The calendar event should be scheduled on March 10, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the America/New_York timezone. The event title should be "Restock: [Product Name]" where the product name is truncated to the first 50 characters if it is longer than that. The description should read "Product ID: [ID]. SKU: [SKU]. Category: [Category Name]. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered." Use the first category name listed for each product. If a product has no category, write "Uncategorized" as the category.

After creating the calendar events, send a single summary email from purchasing@ourstore.com to warehouse@ourstore.com with the subject "Out of Stock Alert - March 2026". The email body should list each out-of-stock product on its own line in the format "ID [Product ID]: [Product Name] (SKU: [SKU])" sorted by product ID ascending. At the bottom of the email, include a line that says "Total out-of-stock products: [N]" where N is the count.

Also save a plain text file called out_of_stock_report.txt in the workspace. Each line should contain "[Product ID] - [Product Name] - [SKU] - [Category]" for the out-of-stock products with each field separated by space-dash-space, sorted by product ID ascending.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Query the WooCommerce product endpoint with the out-of-stock filter at its maximum page size and retain only rows whose literal `stock_quantity` is `0`. Sort the verified list by numeric product ID and derive the report, events, and email from that one list. Write `out_of_stock_report.txt` once. In one native-parallel batch, search the exact 2026-03-10 09:00–10:00 America/New_York interval for every required `Restock: ...` title, create only missing events, and read each resulting event by ID. Then send exactly one email from `purchasing@ourstore.com` to `warehouse@ourstore.com` with subject `Out of Stock Alert - March 2026`, one sorted product line per item, and the exact total-count line.

nodes.text:
You are a planning sub-agent. Decompose the following task into ordered subtasks and return a structured plan. Do NOT perform any writes or mutations — read-only investigation is allowed if needed (you may query the WooCommerce product catalog via mcp__woocommerce__*read/list/get tools, inspect the filesystem workspace via mcp__filesystem__* tools, and inspect email/calendar state read-only).

TASK (from the user, a purchasing department manager):

1. Pull the COMPLETE product catalog from the WooCommerce e-commerce platform (use mcp__woocommerce__woo_products_list with pagination — perPage up to 100 — to fetch ALL products, not just the first page). Identify every product that is currently OUT OF STOCK, meaning stock_quantity is zero. Note: pay attention to how stock is represented (stock_quantity field, stock_status field). Report the exact interpretation of "out of stock with quantity zero" based on what the data shows, including whether manage_stock matters.

2. For each out-of-stock product, create a Google Calendar event (mcp__google_calendar__create_event):
   - Scheduled on March 10, 2026, 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM, timezone America/New_York.
   - Title: "Restock: [Product Name]" where product name is truncated to first 50 characters if longer.
   - Description: "Product ID: [ID]. SKU: [SKU]. Category: [Category Name]. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."
   - Use the FIRST category name listed for each product; if no category, use "Uncategorized".

3. Send ONE summary email via mcp__emails__send_email:
   - From purchasing@ourstore.com (use from_addr) to warehouse@ourstore.com.
   - Subject: "Out of Stock Alert - March 2026".
   - Body: each out-of-stock product on its own line "ID [Product ID]: [Product Name] (SKU: [SKU])", sorted by product ID ascending. At the bottom: "Total out-of-stock products: [N]" where N is the count.

4. Save a plain text file out_of_stock_report.txt in the workspace (workspace path: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-wc-inventory-alert-gcal/workspace). Each line: "[Product ID] - [Product Name] - [SKU] - [Category]" (fields separated by " - "), sorted by product ID ascending.

DELIVERABLE: Return a step-by-step plan with:
- Ordered subtasks.
- For each subtask: dispatch decision (self = main agent, explore = read-only subagent, coder = write-capable subagent), and whether it is independent/parallelizable or must wait on another subtask's output.
- Any data-shape gotchas you discovered (e.g., how many products exist, how stock fields appear, whether SKU can be empty, pagination counts, product names longer than 50 chars, products with no categories).
- A verification strategy for each deliverable (how to confirm calendar events exist, email sent, file contents correct).

Keep the plan concrete and actionable.
